scope: R144 profit fixedFY events, unknown-control sensitivity, current-next paired events
model: New explicit exploratory predictive extension to original descriptive event studies: price pre20/pre60 vs plus revision or current/next; raw features train standardized Ridge alpha10,date-equal weights
state: R195 previous trading close strictly before signal_date; avoids reaction-day state leakage; base/state/interaction
targets: post20/post60; fixedFY also matched_post20/matched_post60 using original same-day controls; current-next raw post only
gate: Annual2020..2026, >=300 mature rows and >=18 distinct calendar months, event date and maturity before Jan1; same complete feature population, target missing retained in predictions
metrics: Date-equal MSE, no IC claim for sparse per-date event sets; compare regime and revision increment
boundary: Exploratory Historical-proxy, selected reports and non-news-control uncertainty retained; no trading or adoption
